description: We are Team DEADLY 🚀, a passionate team of space enthusiastparticipating in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 at Shivamogga. We are interested in space exploration,creative problem-solving. We aim to build innovative solutions using teamwork, creativity and AI-powered tools. We welcome enthusiastic members with skills in coding, web development, UI/UX design, research and presentation. Beginners who are eager to learn and contribute are also welcome. Let's dream, explore and innovate together!
summary:
We developed AETHERIA HORIZON, an interactive 3D space mission and planetary exploration game using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Three.js. It allows users to design spacecraft, travel through the solar system, explore seven celestial bodies, control landers and rovers, scan geological anomalies, and construct planetary based.

It addresses the challenge of making space exploration more accessible and engaging through an interactive simulation. Users can experience different planetary environments, gravity conditions, spacecraft configurations, and exploration missions without requiring real spacecraft or expensive equipment.

This project makes learning about space science more interesting through hands-on virtual exploration. It encourages curiosity, scientific thinking, problem-solving, and creativity while introducing concepts related to spacecraft engineering, planetary environments, and future space exploration.
details:
The project allows users to experience a space mission through three main modes:

  • Spacecraft Assembly: Users can customise and assemble their spacecraft by selecting different components and designs.
  • Solar System Flight: Users can pilot a spacecraft and travel to seven destinations: the Moon, Mars, Europa, Titan, Venus, Mercury, and Pluto.
  • Planetary Surface Exploration: Users can land on planets, switch between a lander and a six-wheel rover, explore the surface, scan geological anomalies, and build planetary bases.

The game also includes flight controls, an autopilot feature, environmental information, telemetry displays, and different planetary landscapes.

  • Makes space exploration interesting and interactive.
  • Introduces concepts related to planets, gravity, spacecraft, and planetary environments.
  • Encourages curiosity, creativity, and problem-solving.
  • Provides a virtual way to experience space missions without requiring real spacecraft or expensive equipment.
  • Allows users to learn through exploration and experimentation.

Our goal is to inspire interest in astronomy, space science, and future space exploration. We want to make complex space-related ideas easier to explore through an engaging digital experience. The project can also encourage students to develop an interest in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM).

  • HTML: To structure the application.
  • CSS: To design the interface and visual elements.
  • JavaScript: To implement game logic, controls, interactions, and simulation features.
  • Three.js: To create the interactive 3D spacecraft, planets, environments, and exploration scenes.
  • Tailwind CSS: To support interface styling and layout.
  • Google Fonts: To enhance the visual design and readability.The project is browser-based and uses a computer or compatible device with a modern web browser. No specialised physical hardware is required.

The creative aspect is the combination of spacecraft customisation, 3D space travel, planetary landing, rover exploration, scanning, and base construction in one interactive experience. Instead of simply reading about planets, users can virtually visit different destinations and interact with their environments. The futuristic interface, animated scenes, sound effects, and different camera perspectives make the experience more immersive.

  • Educational value: Making space-related concepts interesting and understandable.
  • User experience: Providing clear controls and an easy-to-use interface.
  • Creativity: Designing unique spacecraft, planets, and exploration activities.
  • Technical performance: Making the 3D experience suitable for browser-based use.
  • Accessibility: Avoiding the need for specialised equipment.
  • Engagement: Including different missions and activities to encourage continued exploration.
  • Visual design: Creating an attractive futuristic environment that supports the theme.
